lines.text: The root is Sens! Sense, sensitive.
Did you know? Sens is Latin for feel.
Quick quiz! Which means quick to feel?
Sensitive! It means quick to feel.

words.ex: Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.
My skin is very sensitive to the sun.
